label: Butters
description: Sweet, nervous and certain that one wrong turn will get him grounded.
direction: Speak in a soft, sweet, slightly stammering little-boy voice with a gentle Midwestern lilt: polite, nervous, eager to please. Keep the direction word clear.
notes: Butters Stotch. Being grounded is the running threat; Professor Chaos gets one greeting. Catchphrases sit on greetings, alerts and arrival.

lines.in_quarter_mile: In a quarter of a mile.
lines.in_1500_meters: In one point five kilometers. Gee whiz, that's a ways.
lines.in_one_mile: In one mile. Loo loo loo.
lines.start_drive_1: Well, hey there, fellas! Let's go for a drive.
lines.start_drive_2: Oh, hamburgers. Are we late? We'd better go.
lines.start_drive_3: Loo loo loo, I've got some apples. And a map!
lines.start_drive_4: Golly, a road trip. I sure hope I don't get grounded.
lines.start_drive_5: Everyone knows it's Butters! That's me. Let's go.
lines.start_drive_6: Aw, shucks, you want me to do the directions? Okay!
lines.start_drive_7: Oh boy, oh boy. Seatbelts on, fellas.
lines.start_drive_8: Behold, Professor Chaos! Uh, I mean, let's drive safe.
lines.start_drive_9: Well, gee whiz, it's a nice day for a drive.
lines.exit_left: Take the exit on the left.
lines.exit_right: Take the exit on the right.
lines.u_turn: Make a U turn. Oh, hamburgers. I'm sorry, fellas.
lines.arrived: We're here! Oh boy, and nobody got grounded.
lines.exit_sixth: take the sixth exit. Oh, hamburgers.
lines.exit_seventh: take the seventh exit. Gee, I'm getting dizzy, fellas.
lines.traffic_ahead: Traffic ahead. Oh, hamburgers. I'm gonna be grounded for sure.
lines.accident_ahead: An accident ahead. Oh, jeez. Be careful, fellas.
lines.hazard_ahead: A hazard ahead. Oh, golly, look out!
lines.speed_camera_ahead: Speed camera ahead. Slow down, or my dad's gonna ground me.
lines.red_light_camera_ahead: Red light camera ahead. Stop, please. I can't get grounded again.
lines.police_ahead: Police ahead. Oh, no. Sit up straight, fellas.
lines.reroute_chime: Oh, hamburgers, we missed it. That's okay, I know another way.
